<thought>We need the precursors for the deprotection of a TBS‑protected alcohol. The target molecule is the deprotected alcohol given by the SMILES. Applying the TBS‑deprotection template breaks the O‑Si bond, giving the protected alcohol (the same skeleton but with an O‑Si(t‑BuMe₂) group) and a fluoride‑containing silyl fragment (TBS‑F). Thus the two precursors are the TBS‑protected version of the molecule and F[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C. I constructed the protected SMILES by replacing the initial “O” with “O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C”. The final answer is a list containing this pair.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O\", \"F[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C\"]]</final_answer>
